options.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days, 1 or more.
options.endAtFirstDownload: End at the first complete download
options.endAtFirstDownloadDescription: The Share ends as soon as one client has every file.
options.firstDownloaderOnlyDescription: The tracker gives your address to the first client that downloads, and to no other. This controls who learns your address from the tracker, not who can connect.
options.firstDownloaderOnlyUnavailable: Not available with an outside tracker: qui sees no announces.

settings.title: Shares
settings.description: A Share gives the files of one torrent to someone whose client qui does not manage. The Share tracker lets their client find yours.
settings.loadFailed: Failed to load the Share settings
settings.saveFailed: Failed to save the Share settings

inUse.outside: New Shares use the outside tracker.
inUse.none: No tracker is set, so no Share can start.

tracker.heading: Share tracker
tracker.ownDescription: qui listens on its own port only while a Share runs, and answers only for active Shares.
tracker.outsideDescription: For a qui without a public address. qui then sees no announces: the address list and the end at the first download are best effort, and the lock is not available.
tracker.publicAddressDescription: The URL at which the internet reaches this port, with a proxy in front for HTTPS. The .torrent of each Share carries it, so a change waits until the Shares on qui's tracker end.
tracker.trustedProxiesDescription: List only the addresses or CIDR ranges of your proxies, not client networks, one per line. qui reads the forwarded client address only from these proxies.
tracker.trackerUrlDescription: An http, https, or udp announce URL.

dialog.warning: Your friend sees the IP address of your client. Anyone who has the .torrent can download until the Share ends.

result.description_other: Send each .torrent and its message to your friend in your own chat. qui hosts no download link.
